notes: Music tab: tracks Claude finds for your video show up in a new Music tab, with the artist, tempo, length, mood and a line on why each one fits.
Preview with your video: press play on a track to hear it with your video from the playhead, so you can pick the one that fits before you place it.
Music track: Add or drag a track onto its own Music track, then trim it, cut it with the blade, set its level and fade it in and out.
Export with music: Export cut mixes your music in at the level and fades you set, and Claude reads the same details when it rebuilds a composition.
